idea: The one habit that fixed my mornings
text:
What if I told you one thing changed everything in my mornings? [pause] I stopped rushing out the door right after I woke up: [look at camera] here's the thing: it started with just one action: sitting down with my coffee for five minutes every morning: [smile]

First I sat down with my coffee every day: [pause] for six days a week: [look at camera] then I added one more thing: turning off my phone for those five minutes: [pause] that happened every day: [confident] finally I started noticing a difference: [nod]

Now I just sit there with my coffee: [pause] nothing more: [smile] the takeaway is this: let the quiet be your start.
title: The one habit that fixed my mornings
